integrity.computational_extent: complete prime blocks p=3,5,7,11,13; 34 (p,t) pairs; Hensel mod p^2
integrity.evidence_type: symbolic proof with finite independent integer/Hensel verification
integrity.unproved_limits: no claim of novelty certification or exhaustive literature access

limitations: Only odd primes and the consecutive block of polynomial indices p through 2p-2 are classified.
The distinguished factor is local over Z_p; global factorization and Galois groups of full Eulerian polynomials are not determined.
Earlier Eisenstein-type arguments and the tame Kummer classification are established background, not new claims.
Potential equivalent coverage in specialist local-field or Eulerian polynomial literature remains a residual risk.
title: Eulerian polynomials realize every cyclic tame degree-\(p-1\) extension of \(\mathbb Q_p\)
